purpose: Isolate outer-grid refinement for the early scri residual while retaining width7, KO8, all continuum parameters and the inner grid.
map: For x>=.8, r=x+.5*(1-.8)*y^8*(1-y), y=(x-.8)/(1-.8); elsewhere use the identical inner-exp map. J(1)=.5 and the join is C7. No boundary field is frozen or projected.
controls: At each N compare inner-exp and inner-exp-scri with identical parameters. N513 full t6 detects delayed instabilities such as the width9 failure; finer short runs isolate the early scri peak only.
acceptance: Original gates unchanged. A short boundary pilot cannot admit the t10 goal; any selected map requires complete three-grid main/extension and independent controls.
execution: Prepared before launch; start when one of the current evolution workers finishes, without interrupting existing trajectories.
